sections.value: That you, {{defendantName}} on the {{dateOfOffence}} at {{addressOfOffence}}, within the ____ Judicial division, committed an offence punishable under section ___ .

value:
Use this information to enhance the draft.

The role is 'Complainant & Defendant', use if not specify.

This charge template is only used in all federal high court, and in all magistrate's court in the sourth.

If user states the number of count, use it, if they are more than the offence, facts, just repeat counts. {{count}}

 
If user states the offences, use it. {{offence}}

If user states the laws, use it but with caution. {{laws}}

The Complainant in the Federal High Court is sometimes 'The Federal Republic Of Nigeria', or 'The Inspector General Of Police' etc, and in the Magistrate's court, it is 'Commissioner Of Police'.

Where there are so many defendants, you may use eg 'john ....... 1st defendant, becky ...... 2nd defendant' or '1. john, 2. becky ....... defendants.'.

The sequence is 'count one', 'count two', etc. 

There can be so many count, even up to count 100, provided the rules are applied properly.

The draft should be within 300-20000 words.

Use today's date to fill the date section.
